data.name: ServerConnectionDescription
data.value:
To find out which liveries are on your cars, the gallery sends the save file C_ProfileData to the server. The server uses the file only for this and does not store it.
The data from the file is not kept and is not used for anything else. The server keeps the keys needed to decrypt the save file in a safe place.
The server has no connection to the official servers of Forza Horizon, Xbox or Microsoft.

data.name: ServerConsentMessage

The data from the file is not kept and is not used for anything else. The server keeps the keys needed to decrypt the save file in a safe place.
The server has no connection to the official servers of Forza Horizon, Xbox or Microsoft.
Data is sent to the server only with your consent. Turn on the connection to the server?

data.name: DiagnosticsReadmeFormat
data.value:
{0} diagnostics
info.json: the version of the gallery, the versions of Windows and .NET, the interface language and the number of liveries in the cache. settings.json: the settings. Paths and IDs are replaced with <removed>. parse-issues.json: liveries whose files could not be read fully or in part, listed by folder name. logs: the log of the last few days. Known folders and the player ID are replaced with markers such as <save-folder> or <user-id>.
Look through the files before sending them. A value the gallery does not know about, for example a name typed into a folder path, is not replaced.

data.name: ShortcutsNoteFormat
data.value: Letters, digits, {0} and {1} do nothing while the cursor is in a text field. {0}, 3 and G work when exactly one livery is selected.

data.name: SlotsCounterClickHint
data.value: Click to free up room: the extra copies of duplicated liveries go to the archive.

data.name: FreeSpaceNote
data.value: One copy of each duplicated livery stays: one with tags or your own first, else the first downloaded. Locked liveries, liveries on a car, auction liveries and favorites stay as well. Untick a copy to keep it. Everything that goes can be brought back from the archive.

data.name: FreeSpaceNothing
data.value: There is nothing to free: no livery has extra copies that may go. Copies that are locked, on a car, auction liveries or favorites always stay.

data.name: FewFreeSlotsMessageFormat
data.value: Only {0} free slots are left in the save out of {1}. At the limit, the game lets you neither download nor make a livery. Free up room now by moving the extra copies of duplicated liveries to the archive?

data.name: FewFreeSlotsFullMessageFormat
data.value: The save is full: all {0} slots are taken, and the game lets you neither download nor make a livery. Free up room now by moving the extra copies of duplicated liveries to the archive?

data.name: AutoBackupFailedMessage
data.value: The backup before moving to the archive could not be made. Move the liveries to the archive without it?

data.name: LoadingBackupBeforeArchive

data.name: StatusAutoBackupMade

data.name: AutoBackupBeforeArchiveLabel

data.name: AutoBackupOnChangeLabel

data.name: AutoBackupKeepLabel

data.name: AutoBackupHint
data.value: A backup is made only when the newest one does not already hold the save as it is. The oldest automatic backups beyond this number are removed. Backups you make yourself are never removed.

data.name: AuthorIdMissingTooltip
data.value: This livery has no author ID, so the name may belong to anyone. It is a factory livery, an auction livery or one not published. Click to choose the author.

data.name: WarnFewFreeSlotsLabel
data.value: Warn at start when the save is almost full

data.name: AssignAuthorSeveralNote
data.value: None of these liveries has an account as its author ID. The author you choose is set for all of them at once, so choose only if you are sure.
